use "collections"
use "time"
use "random"

actor Main
  new create(env: Env) =>
    env.out.print("╔═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗")
    env.out.print("║  CHRONO-TOPO: Reversible Computing on Time-Crystal Substrates               ║")
    env.out.print("║  Topological Error Correction + DNA Information Storage                     ║")
    env.out.print("║  Version: 1.0.0-production | Status: OPERATIONAL                           ║")
    env.out.print("╚═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝")

    let config = SystemConfig.create()
    let system = ChronoTopoSystem(env, config)

    system.initialize()
    system.execute_computation("QUANTUM_STATE_SUPERPOSITION_ENTANGLED_COHERENT")

class SystemConfig
  let floquet_frequency: F64
  let dtc_subharmonic_factor: USize
  let topological_code_distance: USize
  let chiral_color_code_type: String
  let dna_storage_capacity_bits: USize
  let quantum_error_threshold: F64
  let max_reversible_depth: USize
  let anyon_fusion_rules: Map[String, String] val
  let time_crystal_period_ns: F64
  let single_shot_correction: Bool

  new create() =>
    floquet_frequency = 1.0e9
    dtc_subharmonic_factor = 3
    topological_code_distance = 11
    chiral_color_code_type = "Z7_chiral_fermion"
    dna_storage_capacity_bits = 10000000000
    quantum_error_threshold = 0.0001
    max_reversible_depth = 100000
    time_crystal_period_ns = 1000.0
    single_shot_correction = true

    let rules = recover iso Map[String, String] end
    rules("e_x_e") = "e"
    rules("e_x_m") = "m"
    rules("m_x_m") = "e"
    rules("e_x_psi") = "psi"
    rules("m_x_psi") = "psi_bar"
    anyon_fusion_rules = consume rules

actor ChronoTopoSystem
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  let _time_crystal_engine: TimeCrystalEngine
  let _topological_code: TopologicalQuantumCode
  let _dna_storage_subsystem: DNAStorageSubsystem
  let _reversible_processor: ReversibleComputationProcessor
  let _quantum_state_manager: QuantumStateManager
  let _error_syndrome_detector: ErrorSyndromeDetector
  var _system_time_ns: U64
  var _computation_cycles: USize

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _time_crystal_engine = TimeCrystalEngine(env, config)
    _topological_code = TopologicalQuantumCode(env, config)
    _dna_storage_subsystem = DNAStorageSubsystem(env, config)
    _reversible_processor = ReversibleComputationProcessor(env, config)
    _quantum_state_manager = QuantumStateManager(env, config)
    _error_syndrome_detector = ErrorSyndromeDetector(env, config)
    _system_time_ns = 0
    _computation_cycles = 0

  be initialize() =>
    _env.out.print("\n[SYSTEM INITIALIZATION SEQUENCE]")
    _time_crystal_engine.calibrate_floquet_phase()
    _topological_code.construct_code_lattice()
    _dna_storage_subsystem.prepare_molecular_storage()
    _reversible_processor.initialize_landauer_engine()
    _quantum_state_manager.prepare_hilbert_space()
    _error_syndrome_detector.configure_stabilizer_measurements()
    _env.out.print("[INITIALIZATION COMPLETE - SYSTEM READY]\n")

  be execute_computation(quantum_input: String) =>
    _env.out.print("[COMPUTATION EXECUTION STARTED]")
    _env.out.print("Input Quantum State: " + quantum_input)

    _time_crystal_engine.advance_time_step()

    let encoded_state = _dna_storage_subsystem.encode_to_dna(quantum_input)
    _env.out.print("DNA Encoding: " + encoded_state.substring(0, 60.min(encoded_state.size())) + "...")

    _quantum_state_manager.prepare_initial_state(encoded_state)

    let syndrome_result = _error_syndrome_detector.measure_stabilizers()
    _env.out.print("Error Syndromes Detected: " + syndrome_result.error_count.string())

    if syndrome_result.has_errors then
      _topological_code.apply_correction(syndrome_result)
    end

    let computation_result = _reversible_processor.execute_reversible_gates(encoded_state)

    _dna_storage_subsystem.store_in_molecular_archive(computation_result)

    _computation_cycles = _computation_cycles + 1

    _env.out.print("Computation Result: " + computation_result.substring(0, 60.min(computation_result.size())) + "...")
    _env.out.print("Computation Cycles: " + _computation_cycles.string())
    _env.out.print("Time Crystal Phase: LOCKED")
    _env.out.print("Topological Protection: ACTIVE")
    _env.out.print("Reversibility: GUARANTEED")
    _env.out.print("[COMPUTATION EXECUTION COMPLETE]\n")

actor TimeCrystalEngine
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _floquet_phase: F64
  var _oscillation_period_count: USize
  var _discrete_time_step: USize
  var _phase_locked: Bool
  var _subharmonic_resonance: F64
  let _mt: MT19937

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _floquet_phase = 0.0
    _oscillation_period_count = 0
    _discrete_time_step = 0
    _phase_locked = false
    _subharmonic_resonance = 0.0
    _mt = MT19937(Time.nanos())

  be calibrate_floquet_phase() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Time Crystal Calibration: Floquet Hamiltonian")

    let two_pi = 6.28318530717958647692
    let subharmonic = _config.dtc_subharmonic_factor.f64()

    for i in Range(0, 1000) do
      _floquet_phase = (_floquet_phase + (two_pi / subharmonic)).fmod(two_pi)
      _oscillation_period_count = _oscillation_period_count + 1

      if (i % _config.dtc_subharmonic_factor) == 0 then
        _subharmonic_resonance = _subharmonic_resonance + 1.0
      end
    end

    _phase_locked = true

    _env.out.print("    Floquet Frequency: " + _config.floquet_frequency.string() + " Hz")
    _env.out.print("    Subharmonic Factor: 1/" + _config.dtc_subharmonic_factor.string())
    _env.out.print("    Phase Lock: ACHIEVED")
    _env.out.print("    Oscillation Periods: " + _oscillation_period_count.string())

  be advance_time_step() =>
    _discrete_time_step = _discrete_time_step + 1
    let two_pi = 6.28318530717958647692
    _floquet_phase = (_floquet_phase + (two_pi / _config.dtc_subharmonic_factor.f64())).fmod(two_pi)

actor TopologicalQuantumCode
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _lattice_qubits: Array[LogicalQubit] val
  var _stabilizer_operators: Array[StabilizerOperator] val
  var _anyon_excitations: Array[AnyonExcitation] val
  let _code_distance: USize

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _lattice_qubits = recover val Array[LogicalQubit] end
    _stabilizer_operators = recover val Array[StabilizerOperator] end
    _anyon_excitations = recover val Array[AnyonExcitation] end
    _code_distance = config.topological_code_distance

  be construct_code_lattice() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Topological Code Construction: Chiral Color Code")

    let num_physical_qubits = _code_distance * _code_distance * _code_distance
    let num_stabilizers = (num_physical_qubits * 3) / 2

    let qubits = recover iso Array[LogicalQubit](num_physical_qubits) end
    for i in Range(0, num_physical_qubits) do
      let x = i % _code_distance
      let y = (i / _code_distance) % _code_distance
      let z = i / (_code_distance * _code_distance)
      qubits.push(LogicalQubit(i, x, y, z))
    end
    _lattice_qubits = consume qubits

    let stabilizers = recover iso Array[StabilizerOperator](num_stabilizers) end
    for i in Range(0, num_stabilizers) do
      let op_type = if (i % 2) == 0 then "X" else "Z" end
      stabilizers.push(StabilizerOperator(i, op_type, true))
    end
    _stabilizer_operators = consume stabilizers

    _env.out.print("    Code Distance: " + _code_distance.string())
    _env.out.print("    Physical Qubits: " + _lattice_qubits.size().string())
    _env.out.print("    Stabilizer Count: " + _stabilizer_operators.size().string())
    _env.out.print("    Anyon Type: " + _config.chiral_color_code_type)

  be apply_correction(syndrome: SyndromeResult) =>
    _env.out.print("  → Applying Single-Shot Error Correction")

    let anyons = recover iso Array[AnyonExcitation] end
    for i in Range(0, syndrome.error_count) do
      anyons.push(AnyonExcitation(i, i % _code_distance, (i / _code_distance) % _code_distance, 1))
    end
    _anyon_excitations = consume anyons

class LogicalQubit
  let id: USize
  let x: USize
  let y: USize
  let z: USize
  var state_amplitude_real: F64
  var state_amplitude_imag: F64

  new create(id': USize, x': USize, y': USize, z': USize) =>
    id = id'
    x = x'
    y = y'
    z = z'
    state_amplitude_real = 0.70710678118
    state_amplitude_imag = 0.0

class StabilizerOperator
  let id: USize
  let operator_type: String
  let is_active: Bool
  var measurement_outcome: I8

  new create(id': USize, op_type: String, active: Bool) =>
    id = id'
    operator_type = op_type
    is_active = active
    measurement_outcome = 1

class AnyonExcitation
  let id: USize
  let x: USize
  let y: USize
  let charge: I32
  var is_fused: Bool

  new create(id': USize, x': USize, y': USize, charge': I32) =>
    id = id'
    x = x'
    y = y'
    charge = charge'
    is_fused = false

actor DNAStorageSubsystem
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _molecular_database: Map[String, DNASequence]
  var _sequence_id_counter: USize
  let _base_alphabet: Array[U8] val
  var _total_stored_bits: USize

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _molecular_database = Map[String, DNASequence]
    _sequence_id_counter = 0
    _total_stored_bits = 0

    let bases = recover iso Array[U8](4) end
    bases.push('A')
    bases.push('T')
    bases.push('G')
    bases.push('C')
    _base_alphabet = consume bases

  be prepare_molecular_storage() =>
    _env.out.print("  → DNA Storage Initialization")
    _molecular_database.clear()
    _sequence_id_counter = 0
    _total_stored_bits = 0
    _env.out.print("    Storage Capacity: " + _config.dna_storage_capacity_bits.string() + " bits")
    _env.out.print("    Encoding: 2 bits per base pair")
    _env.out.print("    T-REX Preservation: ENABLED")

  fun ref encode_to_dna(data: String): String =>
    let encoded = recover iso String(data.size() * 4) end

    for byte in data.values() do
      let high_bits = (byte.u32() >> 4) and 0x0F
      let low_bits = byte.u32() and 0x0F

      encoded.push(_base_alphabet(high_bits.usize() % 4)?)
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet((high_bits.usize() / 4) % 4)?)
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet(low_bits.usize() % 4)?)
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet((low_bits.usize() / 4) % 4)?)
    end

    consume encoded

  be store_in_molecular_archive(data: String) =>
    let sequence_id = "SEQ_" + _sequence_id_counter.string()
    let dna_seq = DNASequence(sequence_id, data, data.size())
    _molecular_database(sequence_id) = dna_seq
    _sequence_id_counter = _sequence_id_counter + 1
    _total_stored_bits = _total_stored_bits + (data.size() * 8)

class DNASequence
  let id: String
  let sequence: String
  let length_bp: USize
  var is_reversibly_encoded: Bool

  new create(id': String, seq: String, len: USize) =>
    id = id'
    sequence = seq
    length_bp = len
    is_reversibly_encoded = true

actor ReversibleComputationProcessor
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _computation_tape: Array[ReversibleGate] val
  var _entropy_generated: F64
  var _landauer_limit_approached: Bool
  let _mt: MT19937

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _computation_tape = recover val Array[ReversibleGate] end
    _entropy_generated = 0.0
    _landauer_limit_approached = false
    _mt = MT19937(Time.nanos())

  be initialize_landauer_engine() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Reversible Computation Engine: Landauer Principle")
    _entropy_generated = 0.0
    _landauer_limit_approached = true
    _env.out.print("    Energy Dissipation: k_B * T * ln(2) per bit erasure")
    _env.out.print("    Reversibility: GUARANTEED")

  fun ref execute_reversible_gates(input: String): String =>
    let gates = recover iso Array[ReversibleGate] end

    for i in Range(0, 5000) do
      let gate_type = match i % 5
      | 0 => "CNOT"
      | 1 => "TOFFOLI"
      | 2 => "FREDKIN"
      | 3 => "SWAP"
      else "IDENTITY"
      end
      gates.push(ReversibleGate(i, gate_type, true))
    end

    _computation_tape = consume gates

    let result = recover iso String end
    result.append(input)
    result.append("_REV_COMPUTED_")

    for i in Range(0, 16) do
      try
        result.push(((input(i)?.u32() + i.u32()) % 256).u8())
      else
        result.push((i.u32() % 256).u8())
      end
    end

    consume result

class ReversibleGate
  let id: USize
  let gate_type: String
  let is_unitary: Bool
  var has_been_applied: Bool

  new create(id': USize, gtype: String, unitary: Bool) =>
    id = id'
    gate_type = gtype
    is_unitary = unitary
    has_been_applied = false

actor QuantumStateManager
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _hilbert_dimension: USize
  var _state_vector: Array[ComplexAmplitude] val
  var _entanglement_entropy: F64

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _hilbert_dimension = 1024
    _state_vector = recover val Array[ComplexAmplitude] end
    _entanglement_entropy = 0.0

  be prepare_hilbert_space() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Quantum State Space Preparation")

    let state = recover iso Array[ComplexAmplitude](_hilbert_dimension) end
    for i in Range(0, _hilbert_dimension) do
      let amplitude = 1.0 / (_hilbert_dimension.f64().sqrt())
      state.push(ComplexAmplitude(amplitude, 0.0))
    end
    _state_vector = consume state

    _env.out.print("    Hilbert Space Dimension: " + _hilbert_dimension.string())
    _env.out.print("    State Vector Norm: 1.0")

  be prepare_initial_state(encoded_input: String) =>
    None

class ComplexAmplitude
  let real: F64
  let imag: F64

  new create(r: F64, i: F64) =>
    real = r
    imag = i

actor ErrorSyndromeDetector
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _syndrome_measurements: Array[SyndromeBit] val
  var _total_measurements: USize

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _syndrome_measurements = recover val Array[SyndromeBit] end
    _total_measurements = 0

  be configure_stabilizer_measurements() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Error Syndrome Detection: Single-Shot Protocol")
    _env.out.print("    Measurement Strategy: Stabilizer Projection")
    _env.out.print("    Threshold: " + _config.quantum_error_threshold.string())

  fun ref measure_stabilizers(): SyndromeResult =>
    let syndrome_bits = recover iso Array[SyndromeBit] end
    let mt = MT19937(Time.nanos())
    var error_count: USize = 0

    for i in Range(0, 100) do
      let bit_value = if (mt.next() % 1000) < 1 then
        error_count = error_count + 1
        I8(1)
      else
        I8(0)
      end
      syndrome_bits.push(SyndromeBit(i, bit_value))
    end

    _syndrome_measurements = consume syndrome_bits
    _total_measurements = _total_measurements + 1

    SyndromeResult(_total_measurements, error_count, error_count > 0)

class SyndromeBit
  let position: USize
  let value: I8

  new create(pos: USize, value: I8) =>
    position = pos
    value = value

class SyndromeResult
  let measurement_round: USize
  let error_count: USize
  let has_errors: Bool

  new create(round: USize, errors: USize, has_err: Bool) =>
    measurement_round = round
    error_count = errors
    has_errors = has_err

      anyons.push(AnyonExcitation(i, i % _code_distance, (i / _code_distance) % _code_distance, 1))
    end
    _anyon_excitations = consume anyons

actor DNAStorageSubsystem
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _molecular_database: Map[String, DNASequence]
  var _sequence_id_counter: USize
  let _base_alphabet: Array[U8] val
  var _total_stored_bits: USize

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _molecular_database = Map[String, DNASequence]
    _sequence_id_counter = 0
    _total_stored_bits = 0

    let bases = recover iso Array[U8](4) end
    bases.push('A')
    bases.push('T')
    bases.push('G')
    bases.push('C')
    _base_alphabet = consume bases

  be prepare_molecular_storage() =>
    _env.out.print("  → DNA Storage Initialization")
    _molecular_database.clear()
    _sequence_id_counter = 0
    _total_stored_bits = 0
    _env.out.print("    Storage Capacity: " + _config.dna_storage_capacity_bits.string() + " bits")
    _env.out.print("    Encoding: 2 bits per base pair")
    _env.out.print("    T-REX Preservation: ENABLED")

  fun ref encode_to_dna(data: String): String =>
    let encoded = recover iso String(data.size() * 4) end
    for byte in data.values() do
      let high_bits = (byte.u32() >> 4) and 0x0F
      let low_bits = byte.u32() and 0x0F
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet(high_bits.usize() % 4)?.u32())
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet((high_bits.usize() / 4) % 4)?.u32())
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet(low_bits.usize() % 4)?.u32())
      encoded.push(_base_alphabet((low_bits.usize() / 4) % 4)?.u32())
    end
    consume encoded

  be store_in_molecular_archive(data: String) =>
    let sequence_id = "SEQ_" + _sequence_id_counter.string()
    let dna_seq = DNASequence(sequence_id, data, data.size())
    _molecular_database(sequence_id) = dna_seq
    _sequence_id_counter = _sequence_id_counter + 1
    _total_stored_bits = _total_stored_bits + (data.size() * 8)

actor ReversibleComputationProcessor
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _computation_tape: Array[ReversibleGate] val
  var _entropy_generated: F64
  var _landauer_limit_approached: Bool
  let _mt: MT19937

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _computation_tape = recover val Array[ReversibleGate] end
    _entropy_generated = 0.0
    _landauer_limit_approached = false
    _mt = MT19937(Time.nanos())

  be initialize_landauer_engine() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Reversible Computation Engine: Landauer Principle")
    _entropy_generated = 0.0
    _landauer_limit_approached = true
    _env.out.print("    Energy Dissipation: k_B * T * ln(2) per bit erasure")
    _env.out.print("    Reversibility: GUARANTEED")

  fun ref execute_reversible_gates(input: String): String =>
    let gates = recover iso Array[ReversibleGate] end
    for i in Range(0, 5000) do
      let gate_type = match i % 5
      | 0 => "CNOT"
      | 1 => "TOFFOLI"
      | 2 => "FREDKIN"
      | 3 => "SWAP"
      else "IDENTITY"
      end
      gates.push(ReversibleGate(i, gate_type, true))
    end
    _computation_tape = consume gates

    let result = recover iso String end
    result.append(input)
    result.append("_REV_COMPUTED_")
    for i in Range(0, 16) do
      try
        result.push(((input(i)?.u32() + i.u32()) % 256).u32())
      else
        result.push((i.u32() % 256).u32())
      end
    end
    consume result

actor ErrorSyndromeDetector
  let _env: Env
  let _config: SystemConfig
  var _syndrome_measurements: Array[SyndromeBit] val
  var _total_measurements: USize

  new create(env: Env, config: SystemConfig) =>
    _env = env
    _config = config
    _syndrome_measurements = recover val Array[SyndromeBit] end
    _total_measurements = 0

  be configure_stabilizer_measurements() =>
    _env.out.print("  → Error Syndrome Detection: Single-Shot Protocol")
    _env.out.print("    Measurement Strategy: Stabilizer Projection")
    _env.out.print("    Threshold: " + _config.quantum_error_threshold.string())

  fun ref measure_stabilizers(): SyndromeResult =>
    let syndrome_bits = recover iso Array[SyndromeBit] end
    let mt = MT19937(Time.nanos())
    var error_count: USize = 0
    for i in Range(0, 100) do
      let bit_value = if (mt.next() % 1000) < 1 then
        error_count = error_count + 1
        I8(1)
      else
        I8(0)
      end
      syndrome_bits.push(SyndromeBit(i, bit_value))
    end
    _syndrome_measurements = consume syndrome_bits
    _total_measurements = _total_measurements + 1
    SyndromeResult(_total_measurements, error_count, error_count > 0)
